evals.prompt: Repair a painted NPC walking sprite sheet whose torso jumps whenever a foot lifts and whose loop seam is visible.
evals.expected_output: Inspect the sheet and runtime contract; diagnose per-frame grounding, preserve one origin and character identity; inspect contact, passing and seam poses in a looping preview. Do not equate structural checks with visual acceptance.

evals.prompt: Create a four-direction walk cycle from separated painted character limbs.
evals.expected_output: Measure joints from artwork, prove one canonical gait with opposite leg phases and arm counter-swing, maintain limb lengths and near/far ordering, then propagate and validate at runtime scale.

evals.prompt: Pack reviewed walk poses into a sheet with 128x128 frames, 16 columns, four rows and 12 motion frames starting at column 4.
evals.expected_output: Preserve source poses and stable origin; confirm row directions and timing; pack and run structural validation with the supplied contract; inspect motion preview and report any unavailable live-game review.
